coordinateSystem: 10 columns, zero-based from left; rows bottom-up
provenance: Well coordinates and masks are mathematical encodings of the source definitions, not claimed played positions. LST occupancy pages are exact source diagram decodings.

featureContract.wellObstruction: Count newly occupied preferred-well cells after simulation; do not penalize the I cells of a completed clear. Existing garbage may require changing the usable base or abandoning the well.
featureContract.sideRoughness: Sum absolute adjacent column-height differences separately within leftColumns and rightColumns. Exclude edges crossing the reserved well.
featureContract.sideBalance: For an interior well, compare left/right stack heights as a soft cost, excluding the well. No universal numeric threshold is claimed.
featureContract.quadReady: Require four contiguous rows each exactly matching rowExceptWellMask, an accessible I placement, and an engine simulation that clears four lines. The mask alone is insufficient.
featureContract.tSpinOpportunity: Use reachable rotation paths and engine spin classification at the surface; neither a center well nor equal side heights proves a T-spin.
featureContract.holeCost: Evaluate actual buried empty cells separately; intentional spin cavities must be validated before treating them as useful.
featureContract.commitment: Well-preserving goals are soft style choices; survival, hard constraints and a verified current plan retain priority.

lstPhases.interpretation: L/J-overhang phase: page0 before T, page1 T-color filled, page2 after clear.
S/Z-overhang phase with construction and T-color filled page.

diagramAnnotations.note: Preserved original diagram from LST article; it illustrates ST, not an LST target.
Do not require the preferred well to be empty during every T-spin construction phase.

executionStatus: No runtime routes enabled by surface definitions; all placements require target-engine verification.
